description: This file defines the PskCredential class, representing a credential type for storing Pre-shared Keys (PSK) used in TLS handshakes within the Eclipse Hono project. The class includes a list of secrets, getter and setter methods, and extends the CommonCredential class.

classes.name: PskCredential
classes.description: A credential class for managing Pre-shared Key secrets, extending CommonCredential and including a list of PskSecret instances.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of PSK secrets used for device authentication.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of PSK secrets; throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is empty.
